description: Guards git and forge commands run through the shell tool (refuses tool attribution, bulk staging, hook-bypass flags, force-pushes to protected branches and staged secrets), decides or refuses every commit, push and post, refuses, in agent mode, a secret read or print, a change to the guard's own configuration through any tool or the shell, and a database write that reaches production, and checks the commit that just landed. One string command per hook, so Claude Code and Codex run it the same way. Rules and their ids live in rules/registry.json.
